dataframe_assertion_classification.rationale: The assertions verify input-order preservation, stable column ordering, or ordered mocked storage records.
The record comparisons sort by id before converting to dictionaries.
row(0, named=True) is deterministic because both frames are asserted to contain exactly one row.

windows_xdist_policy.rationale: Windows/Python 3.13 async loop and socketpair limits require conservative local defaults.
